good_thing: (Westerly, Rhode Island): Peanut, a young harbor seal, returned to the ocean on August 26 after more than seven weeks of care at Mystic Aquarium. Found thin, lethargic, and showing signs of infection on the New Hampshire coast, she was treated for injuries and a respiratory infection, gained more than 20 pounds, and was released off Rhode Island.
current_or_history: On August 27, 1900, U.S. Army physician James Carroll allowed an infected mosquito to bite him during research into yellow fever. He developed a severe case, and his experience helped Walter Reed’s team establish that mosquitoes transmit the disease.
tiny_fact: An octopus has three hearts: two pump blood through its gills, while the third circulates oxygenated blood through the rest of its body.
thought: You do not have to solve the whole week today; one kind, useful thing is plenty.
